classes.label: Primary or confirmatory
classes.description: Frozen or prospectively defined studies used for the repository's bounded result claims.

classes.label: Primary source artifact
classes.description: Raw input to a primary combined analysis; interpret it with the linked companion artifact and protocol.

classes.label: Exploratory pilot
classes.description: Pilot or smoke evidence used to test feasibility or choose a later protocol, not a confirmatory result.

classes.label: Mechanism or integration gate
classes.description: Component-level evidence that an implementation contract holds; it is not task-success evidence.

classes.label: Diagnostic
classes.description: A bounded debugging artifact retained for traceability rather than a headline efficacy claim.

classes.label: Rejected from effect analysis
classes.description: Byte-preserved evidence excluded after a documented protocol or pairing failure.

classes.label: Scripted runtime evidence
classes.description: MuJoCo or wire-contract evidence produced with a scripted non-learned policy, not pi0/pi0.5 inference.

classes.label: Planning and control baseline
classes.description: Classical Panda planning, collision, and trajectory-tracking evidence without a learned policy.
